heading: Property network
intro: Keep property projects, service history and member conversations together. Projects stay with their authorized team. Your network profile starts private and is separate from the professional directory.

history_shares.staged: Invitation created. The professional can accept it in History shares.
history_shares.waiting: Checking current access to this property.
history_shares.anchor_help: Choose an active project on this property. You can invite one of its assigned professionals.
history_shares.no_anchor: No active projects you manage are on this page.
history_shares.draft_help: Select completed work from this property and write a short summary for each entry. You can revoke the share at any time.
history_shares.no_professional: This project has no eligible professionals.
history_shares.label: Invitation title
history_shares.label_help: The professional sees this title before accepting. Leave out identifying details.
history_shares.no_entries: No completed work is available on this page.
history_shares.redaction_help: Leave out addresses, names, contact details, links and photos. The professional will see only your summaries, service dates and categories.
history_shares.confirm_review: I reviewed the invitation title and each summary and removed private details.
history_shares.title: Property history shares
history_shares.empty_sent: You haven’t shared any property history.
history_shares.empty_received: You have no current history invitations or shares.
history_shares.invitation_help: Accept to see the selected summaries until this share expires or access is revoked.

confirmations.accept: Accept this invitation to view the selected summaries. This gives you read-only access to this share.
confirmations.decline: Decline this invitation. It will be removed from your received shares.
confirmations.revoke: Revoke access to these summaries. The invitation can no longer be used.

freshness_stale: Not current. A new check is needed.
reload_to_continue: Reload the current record before making another change.
error_access: This record is unavailable or your current account no longer has access.
error_conflict: The record changed. Reload it before making another change.
error_unavailable: This feature is not configured or temporarily unavailable. No success is confirmed.
error_fields: Check the fields and try again after reloading the record.
error_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Reload to check the current state.
projects_intro: Follow work from planning to completion, with private progress photos, milestones and a dated record of what happened.
projects_empty: No projects are accessible to this account yet. Project owners can add existing verified members by their member code.
no_milestones: Progress not set: no active milestones
project_private: Private project: only the owner, assigned active members and authorized admins can view it. No public portfolio is created.
title: Project title
reload_before_new_project: The creation result is unconfirmed. Close this form and refresh the project list before attempting a new project; do not submit another copy.
read_only: Your current project access is read-only.
timeline_note: Entries form a dated record. Add a correction instead of rewriting an earlier entry. Photos and comments remain private to this project.
add_correction: Add a correction to the selected entry
correction_note: This entry corrects an earlier entry in the same project; the original remains in the history.
milestones_note: Progress comes from completed active milestones. Cancelled milestones do not represent completed work.
members_note: Add an existing active, verified account by its member code. This grants project access; it does not create an account, send an invitation or change anyone's global account role.
service_history_note: Progress from projects this account is authorized to view for this listing. Lease, tenant and financial records are not included. A listing reference is not a permanent physical-property registry.
photo_help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each and six photos per entry. Photos require current project or post access. Removing an attachment here only removes it from this draft.
photo_invalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image no larger than 5 MB.
photo_unavailable: Private photo unavailable. Access may have changed.
photo_alt: Private photo attached to this entry
uncertain_submission: This entry's result is unconfirmed. Its exact text, photos and submission reference are retained. Reload the record to inspect it, or retry this same entry; do not compose another copy.
comment_photo_unavailable: A photo that is no longer available
comments_readonly: You can read these comments; posting is not currently allowed.
members_directory_note: Only members who chose member visibility appear here. Private professional drafts, account email addresses and phone numbers are not part of these profiles.
profile_separate: This is your member profile, not a published professional listing. Saving it does not claim or publish any imported professional profile.
status_text: Current status / what I am working on
visibility: Who can see my network profile?
visibility_private: Private — only me and authorized admins
visibility_note: Choose member visibility deliberately. Your account email, phone, private property projects and financial records are never added to your network profile.
wall_policy: Who can post on my wall?
wall_approval_required: Members can submit; I approve first
enable_comments: Allow comments on visible wall posts
save_profile_first: Save your network profile before adding posts. It stays private unless you choose otherwise.
wall_note: Wall visibility follows the profile. Photos stay behind authenticated access. Posts submitted by another member wait for approval before becoming visible.
your_wall_post: Post an update on my wall
wall_submission_note: Submit a post for this member to review. It will not appear to other members until approved.
wall_owner_only_note: This member accepts posts only from the profile owner.
block_note: Block another member's network profile and wall interaction. This does not replace project membership controls or revoke access to a shared project. Use the project team section to revoke project access.

registry.heading: My private properties
registry.intro: Register a private workspace for a property you own, manage or are authorized to sell, even when it has no listing. Keep its projects and authorized service history together.
registry.unverified: This is a private workspace, not a public listing or proof of ownership. Your relationship and authority are self-declared and have not been independently verified.
registry.empty: No private properties match this view. Add a property only when you have authority to manage this private workspace.
registry.creation_unavailable: Your current account cannot create a private property workspace. Refresh to check your current access.
registry.no_active_source: No eligible active private property is available on this page. Browse another page or add a property under My private properties first.
registry.title: Private property name
registry.authority: I confirm that I am authorized to create and manage this private property workspace. This does not verify ownership or publish a listing.
registry.uncertain: The save result is unconfirmed. Your fields and the same submission reference are retained. Check the result before deciding whether to retry this same save; no automatic retry occurs.
registry.not_found_submission: No property was found for this save reference. Your draft is retained. You may explicitly retry the same save; this check has not created a property.
registry.refresh_keep_draft: Refresh record and retain my draft
registry.refresh_required: The previous record is no longer shown. Your draft is retained and locked. Refresh the actual record before making another change.
registry.draft_retained: Unsaved text is retained. Background checks do not replace your draft.
registry.new_version: A newer version is available. Refresh the record to use its current version while retaining your draft, then review your changes before saving.
registry.archive_confirm: Archive this private property? Existing projects and history remain accessible to their authorized teams, but no new project can be created for it.
registry.save_before_archive: Save or deliberately leave your draft before archiving or opening a new project.
registry.archived_note: This property is archived. Existing projects and authorized history remain; new projects are not allowed.
registry.project_unavailable: Your current access does not allow creating a project for this property.
registry.create_project: Create a project for this property
registry.history_note: Only service history from projects you currently have access to is shown. Project membership does not grant access to the property's private address, location, relationship or notes. Archiving retains this history.
registry.uncertain_project: The project save result is unconfirmed. Its exact fields and submission reference are retained. Check the result or explicitly retry this same save; no automatic retry occurs.
registry.not_found_project: This save reference did not return an accessible project. Your request is retained. This check has not created a project or restored revoked access.

work.title: Service visit and completion
work.privacy: Manage the awarded work here. Scheduling and review notes stay in this service request. An approved completion summary is added to project and property history.
work.time_zone: Times are shown in Santo Domingo (UTC−04:00).

proposed_visit.owner: Visit proposed by the property owner

work.share_in_history: I approve this completion summary and understand it will appear in the project timeline and property service history for people with access.
work.action_unavailable: This action is no longer available. Close the draft and review the current record.

help.propose_visit: Choose a future time in Santo Domingo. A previously confirmed time stays in effect until a new time is accepted.
help.accept_visit: Confirm the proposed time and duration shown above.
help.decline_visit: Decline the proposed time. Any previously confirmed visit stays in effect.
help.cancel_visit: Cancel the visit for this awarded request. A new time can be proposed later.
help.request_completion: Describe the work completed and give its completion date. The property owner reviews the summary before it can be added to the project history.
help.request_changes: Explain what the provider should change. This note stays in the service request.
help.approve_completion: Review the completion summary and date above before approving the work.

conversation.heading: Private conversation
conversation.privacy: Messages are visible to the property owner and the awarded provider.
conversation.negotiation_privacy: Only the property owner and this provider can read these messages while the request is open.
conversation.limit: Use up to {{limit, number}} characters of plain text.

review.title: Private service review
review.privacy: Only the property owner and the awarded provider can see this review.
review.one_review: You can save one review for this service.
review.limit: Use up to {{limit, number}} characters of plain text.
review.invalid_comment: Use plain text with up to {{limit, number}} characters.

rebook.title: Repeat service request
rebook.unavailable: This service is no longer available to request again.
rebook.changed: The service details changed. Review the current details before sending.

favorites.title: Saved professionals
favorites.removed: Professional removed from your saved list.
favorites.empty: You haven't saved any professionals yet.

reminders.title: Maintenance reminders
reminders.in_app: When enabled, reminders appear here using Santo Domingo dates.
reminders.changed: The reminder changed. Review the current settings before saving.
reminders.empty: There are no maintenance reminders for this property.

due_work.title: Due-work reminders
due_work.in_app: Your settings apply only to you in this project. Dates and times are shown in Santo Domingo time.
due_work.empty: No due work matches your reminder settings.
due_work.disabled: Turn on a reminder type to see due work here.

operations.title: Service operations
operations.empty_managed: No service requests need attention in this view.
operations.empty_received: No received requests need attention in this view.

stages.visit_completion_due: Visit ready for a completion request

service.intro: Private service requests between existing members who choose to offer services. Agree on terms here, then track awarded work in a private project.
service.unverified: Property ownership and professional qualifications are not independently verified here.
service.opt_in_help: Choose whether signed-in members can find your alias and selected services. This does not publish a professional profile or verify qualifications.
service.opt_in: Let members find me for these services
service.opt_out_help: Turning this off hides you from new requests and pauses new acceptance, quotes, counters and awards on unawarded requests. Permitted history, decline and withdrawal remain available. Existing project access is managed separately.
service.uncertain: The result is not confirmed. Your exact action is retained. Check its result before deciding what to do next.
service.ambiguous_result: No accessible result was found. This does not prove the action failed. Current access was checked separately; an explicit next action is still required.
service.review_conflict: Review a new attempt, keeping my draft
service.changed_review: This changed while you were working. Your draft is kept. Review the current record before continuing.
service.review_current: Review current record, keeping my draft
service.no_sources: No eligible property is on this page. Add a private property or review another page.
service.discovery_help: Only existing members who opted in for this service and property context appear. Selecting someone does not create a quote, appointment or project.
service.no_providers: No opted-in members match this service and property context right now.
service.requester_alias: Name or alias to share for this request
service.not_appointment: A desired date or duration estimate is not a scheduled appointment.
service.shared_warning: Do not include an exact address, phone number, email or private property records. Selected members can read what you write here.
service.share_ack: I authorize sharing these fields only with the selected members.
service.source_refresh: Refresh property availability and matching members before continuing.
service.empty_requests: No authorized service requests match this view.
service.accept_help: Accepting lets you prepare a quote. Work is awarded separately.
service.currency_help: USD and DOP are shown separately. Estimates and fixed quotes are labeled; no currency conversion or recommendation is made.
service.confirm_action: Continue with this action? Existing authorized history will be retained.
service.expiry_help: Valid through the end of this date in Dominican Republic time. Eligibility is checked when accepting or awarding.
service.informational: Quote terms only. This app does not collect payments.
service.project_audience: Later assigned project participants can read this title and summary. Do not include private addresses, contacts, prices or negotiation history.
service.project_ack: I approve this title and summary for the winning professional and later assigned project participants.
service.award_help: Review the exact latest proposal. Awarding creates one private project with the chosen professional; other recipients receive no project access.

leave_confirm: Leave this screen and discard the unsaved draft?
